n1.speaker: bennett
n1.text: Hello again! Weren't you here yesterday afternoon?

translations.fa: دوباره سلام! دیروز بعدازظهر اینجا نبودید؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, I was studying for my English test.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، داشتم برای امتحان انگلیسیم درس می‌خوندم.

branches.suggestion: Yes, I was looking for a cookbook.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، دنبال یه کتاب آشپزی می‌گشتم.

n2.speaker: bennett
n2.text: I thought so! You were sitting by the window. Were you reading the newspaper too?

translations.fa: فکر کردم! کنار پنجره نشسته بودید. روزنامه هم می‌خوندید؟

branches.suggestion: No, I was doing grammar exercises.
branches.suggestionFa: نه، داشتم تمرین گرامر حل می‌کردم.

branches.suggestion: Yes, I was reading about football.

n3.speaker: bennett
n3.text: Very good. Now, while you were working, a lady left this scarf. Was she sitting next to you?

translations.fa: خیلی خوب. حالا، وقتی داشتید کار می‌کردید، یه خانم این شال گردن را جا گذاشت. کنار شما نشسته بود؟

branches.suggestion: Oh, that's Maggie's scarf! She was helping me.
branches.suggestionFa: آه، این شال مگیه! داشت کمکم می‌کرد.

branches.suggestion: I'm not sure. I wasn't paying attention.

n4.speaker: bennett
n4.text: Ah, Maggie! She comes every Tuesday. She was telling me about her garden while I was stamping her books.

translations.fa: آه، مگی! هر سه‌شنبه میاد. وقتی کتاب‌هاش را مهر می‌زدم داشت دربارهٔ باغچه‌ش بهم می‌گفت.

branches.suggestion: I can take the scarf home for her.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونم شال را براش ببرم خونه.

n5.speaker: bennett
n5.text: That would be kind. And would you like a library card? Then you can borrow books for free.

translations.fa: لطف می‌کنید. کارت کتابخونه هم می‌خواید؟ اون‌وقت می‌تونید رایگان کتاب قرض بگیرید.

branches.suggestion: Yes, please! How many books can I borrow?
branches.suggestionFa: آره لطفاً! چندتا کتاب می‌تونم قرض بگیرم؟

branches.suggestion: Do I need proof of address?

cultureNote.en: British public libraries are free to join. You often need a utility bill or a letter as proof of address.
cultureNote.fa: عضویت کتابخانه‌های عمومی بریتانیا رایگان است.

n6.speaker: bennett
n6.text: Up to ten, for three weeks. Just fill in this form. Welcome to the library!

translations.fa: تا ده‌تا، برای سه هفته. فقط این فرم را پر کنید. به کتابخونه خوش اومدید!
